title: BestConfigProtectedPublish403
description: The 403 body of a PROTECTED POST /api/v1/best-configs: the closed refusal envelope (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) restricted to `forbidden` (the permission or project-role decorators denied the caller, fixed text) or `head_write_unauthorized` (the caller lacks agent WRITE authorization). A malformed protected body matches nothing. The execution endpoint combines this with the unchanged legacy 403 body in two DISJOINT branches (the legacy branch must not carry either closed code).
